description: This file defines a generic Java interface named EntityPopulator, which declares methods for converting or populating entities from source objects to target objects within the context of a MerchantStore. It is likely used as a contract for implementing classes responsible for data transformation or mapping in the application.

classes.name: EntityPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for converting source objects into target entities, with methods to populate an existing target or create a new one based on a source object, considering the merchant store context.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object into a target entity, populating existing target, with access to merchant store information. May throw a ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object into a new target entity, without passing an existing target, and may throw a ConversionException.
